name: net.sjstorage/site
title: SJ Storage
description: SJ Storage availability, prices, policies, hours and prefilled rental enquiry links.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Read-only: checks the SJ Storage public availability feed for unit types, sizes, monthly rent, deposits and open counts. Optional unit type or size matches the current feed or the published sizes. A published size absent from the feed is not listed as open right now. The snapshot is shared for about 60 seconds. Nothing is held or reserved; the reserve step rechecks. Missing types are not treated as zero.

unit.description: Type code, label or size from the feed, or a published size such as 8x20 or 12x30. Without a filter, all reported types are listed.

tools.name: build_rental_link
tools.description: Builds a link to the SJ Storage rental page with a published unit size and optional move-in date prefilled in its enquiry form. No unit is held, no payment is taken and no personal details are accepted. Availability is confirmed on the page or by the office. The person reviews and sends the enquiry.

tools.name: get_units_and_prices
tools.description: The two storage unit sizes SJ Storage rents (8x20 drive-up outdoor container, 12x30 powered indoor unit) with monthly rent and refundable deposit exactly as the site publishes them, from the Storage Units in Twin Falls page and the rates table on the availability page. Optionally one unit. It never states whether a unit is open: current availability is on the availability page it links.

unit.description: Optional unit size; both sizes are returned by default.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Where SJ Storage is (225 Blake St S, Twin Falls, ID 83301) as the site describes it, the Google Maps directions link the site publishes, its approximate drive times from Twin Falls landmarks, and its pages for nearby towns (Kimberly, Filer, Hansen, Jerome, Buhl).

tools.name: get_hours
tools.description: Gate and access hours as the site publishes them: the hours on the contact page and the FAQ answers on gate hours, 24/7 and 24-hour access, weekends and holidays. The site publishes one set of hours (the gate hours); it lists no separate office hours.

tools.name: get_features
tools.description: What every unit includes as the site lists it (gated keypad entry and its hours, 24/7 video surveillance, drive-up loading, month-to-month lease signed online, payment options, power in the 12x30), the homepage amenities list, and the site's own "good fit / look elsewhere" lists (it has no small lockers, no climate control and no 24-hour gate access).

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: What the site says about a policy, quoted from its FAQ and pages: deposit, fees, lease term and moving out, missed payments, what you need to rent, prohibited items and use, insurance, climate control, access and authorized users. Where a term is not published (late fee amounts, notice periods, proration), the answer quotes the site's own statement that the signed rental agreement governs it. Without `topic`, it returns the list of topics.

topic.description: Optional policy topic; the topic list is returned by default.

tools.name: how_to_rent_and_pay
tools.description: How to rent a unit, as the site describes it (check availability, sign the lease online, pay the first month and deposit, bring a lock and move in), the payment methods it accepts, its online payment page. Links only: this tool never reserves a unit, signs a lease, reads an account or takes a payment.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Returns the published SJ Storage phone, email, contact-page link, address, directions, hours and social links. It sends nothing and accepts no personal details or message text. Contact-page prefill URLs, if created outside this tool, may expose query text to browser history, hosting logs and consented analytics.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: The site's FAQ answers as published: the FAQ page (51 questions) and the questions on the Storage Units in Twin Falls page. An optional word query matches published answers; without a query, results contain the first five answers.

query.description: Optional search words; the first five answers are returned by default.

limit.description: At most this many answers (default 5, maximum 10).

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Finds pages on sjstorage.net by words (every page in its sitemap: units and prices, sizing guide, space calculator, RV and boat, powered units, commercial, town pages, comparisons, blog, FAQ, contact and the legal pages). Returns up to `limit` pages with title, link and the page's own description, best match first.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "winter RV storage".

limit.description: How many pages at most (1 to 10, default 5).
